preconditions.description: The total number of nodes n must be between 3 and 200,000.
The number of exit-nodes k must be between 2 and n - 1.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output must contain the minimum possible distance between the two most distant exit-nodes.
The output must contain exactly n - 1 lines describing the connections between nodes.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n for u, v in wires)
postconditions.description: Each connection must involve valid node IDs within the range from 1 to n.
